channel.title: MyRecon — The Breach Files
channel.description: Data breach coverage: who was hit, what was taken, how many people it reached and what to do about it.

item.title: Paidwork data breach — 23,272,765 accounts exposed
item.description: 23,272,765 accounts exposed. Severity 75/100 (Severe). Data exposed: Bank account numbers, Dates of birth, Device information, Education levels, Email addresses, Financial transactions, Genders, IP addresses, Names, Passwords, Personal interests, Phone numbers, Physical addresses, Profile photos.

item.title: Addi data breach — 34,532,941 accounts exposed
item.description: 34,532,941 accounts exposed. Severity 77/100 (Severe). Data exposed: Age groups, Credit scores, Device information, Email addresses, Government issued IDs, Income levels, IP addresses, Latitude and longitude pairs, Names, Phone numbers, Physical addresses, Purchases, Socioeconomic levels.
